name: multigo
description: multiGO - a real-time multiplayer Go salon with pastel animal avatars

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared --if-present && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
